# English Exercises

> > Free printable ESL exercises and discussion questions for English learners, organized by CEFR levels (A2-B2) covering grammar, vocabulary, and speaking activities.

English Exercises provides interactive and downloadable resources for ESL/EFL teachers and students, including discussion questions, vocabulary exercises, and grammar practice materials aligned with Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) standards.

## Key Topics

- CEFR A2-B1 (Pre-intermediate to Intermediate)
- CEFR A2 (Elementary)
- CEFR A2-B2 (Elementary to Upper-Intermediate)
- Discussion Questions
- Speaking Activities
- ESL Conversation Practice
- Grammar Practice
- Vocabulary Learning
- Future Tenses
- Quantifiers (Much/Many)
- Subject-Verb Agreement
- Adjective Order
- Business English
- Intermediate English
- Printable Worksheets

## Discussion Questions & Speaking Activities

- [What Will Happen Next? Discussion Questions PDF](https://www.english-exercises.org/discussion-questions/future-tenses-discussion): Future tenses discussion questions PDF for ESL conversation (CEFR A2-B1)
- [How Much? How Many? (Quantifiers) Discussion Questions PDF](https://www.english-exercises.org/discussion-questions/quantifiers-discussion): Quantifiers discussion questions worksheet for ESL practice (CEFR A2)
- [Describing Things Around You Discussion Questions PDF](https://www.english-exercises.org/discussion-questions/adjective-order-discussion): Adjective order discussion questions for describing things (CEFR A2-B2)
- [Subject-Verb Agreement Discussion Questions PDF](https://www.english-exercises.org/discussion-questions/subject-verb-agreement): Subject-verb agreement discussion questions for grammar practice

## Vocabulary Exercises

- [Business English Vocabulary](https://www.english-exercises.org/business-vocabulary): 30 essential business vocabulary words with interactive exercises
- [Christmas Vocabulary Exercises](https://www.english-exercises.org/christmas-vocabulary-exercises): 20 interactive Christmas vocabulary exercises for holiday English learning
